== Description ([[Astrography]] & [[Planetology]]) == 
=== Stellar Data ===
'''Pallique''' is a binary star system.
* Both are red main sequence stars.
** They are close companions.

{{BinaryStarSystem
|name            = Pallique
|primary         = M0 V 
|secondary       = M1 V
|PrimaryName     = Primary
|PrimaryNotes    = 
|SecondaryName   = Secondary
|SecondaryNotes  = [[Astronomical Unit|Approximately 0.03 AU]] from the primary.
}}

=== System Data ===
The worlds of the [[system]] have been surveyed. They consist of:
* The [[mainworld]].
* x2 secondary [[world|rocky worlds]].
* x2 [[planetoid belt]]s.

Pallique is a captured planet; its eccentric orbit is inclined almost perpendicularly to the system's ecliptic plane. Pallique suffers a series of planetary impacts twice each local year as the planet passes through the inner edge of the outer [[planetoid belt]]. As a result of the navigation hazards the [[IISS]] has registered the world as an [[Amber Zone]]. {{Page cite|name=The Regency Sourcebook|page=47}}

=== Mainworld Data ===
'''Pallique''' is an icy planet with only a [[Trace Atmosphere|trace nitrogen atmosphere]]; its eccentric orbit results in a highly variable climate. 

It orbits within its star's [[habitable zone]].
* It receives moderate levels of [[Electromagnetic Spectrum|stellar energy]].

[[File:Chart Orbit HZ Region Simple.png|600 px]]

==== [[Planetary Size|Mainworld Size]] (S) ====
{{WorldSize|name= Pallique|Size= 5}}

==== [[Atmosphere|Mainworld Atmosphere]] (A) ====
{{WorldAtmo|name= Pallique|Atmosphere= 1}}
* Throughout most of the local year it experiences [[Celsius|very low temperatures]].
* During the two "bombardment seasons", at the world's two perihelia, temperatures may reach [[Celsius|moderate levels]].

==== [[Hydrosphere|Mainworld Hydrosphere]] (H) ====
'''Pallique''' has 05-15% of its surface covered by ice, either in vast sheets or contained deep within craters or fractures on the surface. Wilderness refueling is possible. Water for the inhabitants can be obtained by mining and melting ice.
* The surface of the world is composed of a crust of ice many kilometers thick.
* Much of the surface is cratered and covered in thick layers of regolith and dust of meteoric origin, leaving only a part of the icy outer shell exposed.
* Below the outer icy shell there may be a world-ocean of liquid water.

[[File:Twilight Zone World Horizon Type 07p3.jpg|600 px]]

== History & Background (Dossier) ==
[[File:Comp-Prog-Dav-R-Deitrick-Starter-Trav-Page-16 16-July-2018a.jpg|right]]
'''Pallique''' is a ''[[Amber Zone|Puzzle World]]'' and is designated as an [[Amber Zone]]. It presents particular risks and dangers due to the [[environment]] or [[Life Form|native life forms]], [[Law Level|laws]] or [[Custom|customs]], or other conditions that are not well understood.
* Visitors are advised to act with caution.

Pallique suffers a series of planetary impacts twice each local year due to its orbit carrying it through a [[planetoid belt]]. As a result of the hazard the [[IISS]] has registered the world as an [[Amber Zone]].{{Page cite|name=The Regency Sourcebook|page=47}}

The system's two extremely rich [[planetoid belt]]s provided the primary draw for settlement and development. Despite its inhospitable nature, Pallique's location and abundant resources have led it to become a high-population, high-technology world. Among the most famed exports are its vacuum survival gear.
